payload.text: hv, 22 Oct 2026, directly to vc, on the Rust toolchain for kovacs's lint twin: "Why do we need both versions? Answer: we don't. Just use 1.99.1". vc's reading. (1) kovacs keeps one toolchain, rustup's stable 1.99.1 (CI's newer line); the 1.99.0 kovacs-sysadm added on hv's earlier pick is uninstalled. (2) dc's rust-lint (fmt and clippy) on 1.99.1 counts as the twin of CI's Rust Lint job whichever line a CI run draws, so a clean lint there is green, with no rc 3 for a mismatch; this holds for 0101's K1 and for 2.14.2's final-head gate. (3) CI's own runs on main still read as they come; a red there reopens its issue.
